ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity black pixels (estimated >85%) with localized high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated exclusively at the distal tips of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity mottle on the distal left lobe tip; smaller, fragmented high-intensity patch on the distal right lobe tip; central and medial regions consist of a solid low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, lateral terminal points on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (likely barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (scratches) within the high-intensity white patch on the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion/jaggedness of the trailing edge boundary; prominent vertical structural ridging and indentations visible in the central fluke region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity pixel noise from water spray and droplets partially occluding the lower ventral surface boundary.
